name: shiftstart-it-support-kb-jekyll
description: Enterprise-scale technician-first IT support knowledge base built with Jekyll, Tailwind and a multi-select symptom matcher.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run vendor && npm run generate && npm run css && bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.dev: npm run vendor && npm run generate && npm run css && concurrently "tailwindcss -i ./_assets/css/tailwind.css -o ./assets/css/site.css --watch" "bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload"
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run build
